title: finding(scripts): `check-lint-coverage`'s ratchet banner says in the present tense that the closing-keyword shape "still stands" in two named gates — one half was already false, the other goes false when objectui#9898 lands
body:
Dedup keywords: `check-lint-coverage` · ratchet banner · closing keyword · `still stands` · stale cross-file claim

Surfaced by the `os-dev` seat delivering objectui#9598 (PR objectui#9898), which ⛔ correctly declined to reshape a file its card did not reach and reported instead. **Re-measured in this seat before filing** — ⛔ not adopted from the report.

⛔ No `domain:*`, no `type`, no `priority:*` — grading and routing are the triage seat's.

Reading tree: objectui `main` = `c1f039a67ac5cafe2fa04ef11d02fc6ff338d391`.

## The claim

`scripts/check-lint-coverage.mjs:117`–`:120`, inside the DEBT ratchet's banner:

> The landed precedent is the rule-2 stale-entry message in `scripts/check-spec-symbol-derivation.mjs`; **the same shape still stands in `scripts/check-type-check-coverage.mjs` and `scripts/check-action-forward-parity.mjs`**, which this change deliberately does not reach.

## The measurement

Instrument: the `CLOSING_TRIGGER` regex the four landed pins in this family share byte-for-byte — a closing keyword (`close`/`fix`/`resolve`, any tense) immediately before an anchor, accepting an interpolated OR literal anchor and an `owner/repo` | `objectui` | `objectstack` qualifier. Counting rule: total matches in the whole file.

| file the banner names | on `main` today | after objectui#9898 (queued) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `scripts/check-action-forward-parity.mjs` | **0** | 0 |
| `scripts/check-type-check-coverage.mjs` | **3** | **1** |

⇒ **the first half is already false**, and has been since objectui#9755 landed (2026-09-18T02:20Z). The second half goes false when objectui#9898 merges, and the residual `1` there is `:128` — the NOUN `fix` in a source comment (`// … the fix objectstack#4074 applied in \`types\`.`), ⛔ not an emitter and not a surface GitHub parses for closing grammar.

## ⚠️ Why this is not obviously a one-line delete

The sentence is genuinely two-faced and a repair has to pick which it is:

- Read as a **present-tense claim about the tree**, it is a live falsehood in a banner whose whole job is to be believed by the next person editing an emitter. That is the AGENTS.md #9 rot shape: a figure stated in a comment that nothing derives, going stale silently.
- Read as a **record of PR objectui#9595's scope decision** — and the trailing clause "which this change deliberately does not reach" pushes hard that way — it is a historical note, accurate about what that PR chose, and deleting it erases the reason a reviewer would have wanted.

⇒ the repair is probably "keep the scope record, drop or tense-shift the tree claim", but that is a judgement about what the banner is FOR, and this seat does ⛔ not make it by fiat inside another card.

## What this card is NOT

⛔ Not a re-opening of objectui#9595, objectui#9598, objectui#9755 or objectui#9537. Every emitter those cards were about is repaired; this is only the sentence that describes them.

⛔ Not a proposal to add a gate that would keep such cross-file claims honest. That is Part 2 of objectui#9598, and the maintainer ruled it out on 2026-09-18T03:58Z (batch #152 item 3, letter 1): a new required gate is the human floor and the standing direction is no further gate development. ⛔ This card must not be used as the fifth-occurrence evidence that ruling reserves — it is a stale sentence, not a fifth emitter.

## Suggested acceptance

- The banner no longer asserts, in the present tense, something the tree contradicts.
- Whatever survives cites by the names of the things rather than by line address (root `AGENTS.md` commandment #11), as the repaired banners in `check-type-check-coverage.mjs` now do.
- ⚠️ Sequence after objectui#9898 lands, or the second half of the sentence is still true while the work is in flight and the repair will read as wrong to its own reviewer.

## Provenance

Found by the `os-dev` seat on objectui#9598 and reported rather than widened into, per its dispatch order's turn-back clause. Re-measured here by the `domain:ui` execution seat, `session_012EpHzwH4wTy5sd7ibkD2yq`, 2026-09-18T14:1xZ, with the four-pin `CLOSING_TRIGGER` rather than the narrower interpolated-anchor rule — ⚠️ that narrower rule is the one my own objectui#9598 dispatch order used, and it under-counts this family by design.
